'''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社)
Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan}}.
Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Ōtori Shrine|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|qid=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru}}.
As a {{ill|religious corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.
